title: Optional file scan overlay for cicd-guardrails
description: Optional `.guardrails.file-patterns.yml` in the scanned repository. Merges additively with built-in defaults shipped in the guardrails scripts.

global_excludes.description: Additional find -not -path globs merged with the built-in excludes (*/.git/*, */node_modules/*, */.venv/*, */target/*, */.next/*, */.nuxt/*, */.output/*, */.turbo/*, */.cache/*, */__pycache__/*, */coverage/*). Overlay entries add to that list; they never remove built-ins.

validation_skip_paths.description: Relative paths still discovered but excluded from manifest and lock policy validation for CICD-SEC-03 (including Python package_policy scans).

package_policy.description: Optional overrides merged over the guardrails-shipped ecosystem defaults for CICD-SEC-03.

python.description: Partial merge over scripts/config/package_policy.defaults.yml (per-key replacement for arrays and maps).

triggers.description: Basenames that mark a directory as a Python project when present.

satisfiers.description: Basenames; at least one must exist beside triggers when any trigger is present.

allowed_trigger_combinations.description: When more than one trigger basename is present, the set must match one combination exactly (order ignored).

hash_validators.description: Maps satisfier basename to a built-in validator id (pip_requirements_txt_hashes, poetry_lock_hashes, uv_lock_hashes).

javascript.description: Partial merge over scripts/config/package_policy.javascript.defaults.yml. Exact package.json, tsconfig.json, and jsconfig.json basenames identify projects by default; npm, Yarn, pnpm, and Bun lockfiles are supported.

triggers.description: Exact basenames that identify JavaScript/TypeScript project directories; default config filenames such as tsconfig.app.json are not matched.

allowed_trigger_combinations.description: Exact allowed trigger sets in one directory. The shipped defaults allow package.json alone or package.json beside exactly one of tsconfig.json and jsconfig.json.

allowed_satisfier_combinations.description: Exact allowed lockfile-family sets in one package.json directory.

hash_validators.description: Maps lockfile basename to npm_lock_integrity, yarn_lock_integrity, or pnpm_lock_integrity.
